description: This file defines TypeScript classes representing event type outputs for a scheduling application, including base classes, specific event type classes, and related nested classes with validation and API documentation decorators.

classes.name: User_2024_06_14
classes.description: Represents a user with properties like id, name, username, avatarUrl, weekStart, brandColor, darkBrandColor, and metadata.

classes.name: EventTypeTeam
classes.description: Represents a team associated with an event type, including id, slug, bannerUrl, name, logoUrl, weekStart, brandColor, darkBrandColor, and theme.

classes.name: BaseEventTypeOutput_2024_06_14
classes.description: Base class for event type output, including id, length, title, slug, description, locations, booking fields, and various configuration options.

classes.name: EventTypeOutput_2024_06_14
classes.description: Extends base class with ownerId, users, and bookingUrl for individual event types.

classes.name: TeamEventTypeResponseHost
classes.description: Represents a host in a team event type, including name, username, and optional avatarUrl.

classes.name: TeamEventTypeOutput_2024_06_14
classes.description: Extends base class with team-specific properties like teamId, ownerId, parentEventTypeId, hosts, schedulingType, team info, email settings, and host assignment options.

methods.name: getSchemaPath
methods.description: Function to retrieve JSON schema path for referenced output classes.

methods.name: ValidateOutputLocations_2024_06_14
methods.description: Validation decorator for output location arrays.

methods.name: ValidateOutputBookingFields_2024_06_14
methods.description: Validation decorator for booking fields arrays.
